hints.title: Check Divisors up to Square Root
hints.text: For each integer x, find its divisors by checking integers d from 1 up to sqrt(x).

hints.title: Paired Divisors
hints.text: When d divides x, both d and x / d are divisors. If d * d == x, only count d once.

hints.title: Filter for Exactly Four Divisors
hints.text: If the total divisor count for an integer is exactly 4, add the sum of those 4 divisors to the total accumulator.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all integers up to M for each element is too slow when M reaches 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking divisors only up to square root of each number drops complexity to O(sqrt(M)).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes square root factorization and aborts early if divisor count exceeds 4.
